claims.text: Gazette Extraordinary No. 28 of Monday 16th September 2019, headed 'DEATH OF THE PRIME MINISTER HONOURABLE SAMUELA 'AKILISI POHIVA' (Tongan: 'KO E PEKIA 'A E 'EIKI PALEMIA KO SAMUELA 'AKILISI POHIVA'), directs that to honour 'the late Prime Minister' the flag be flown at half-mast throughout the Kingdom and at every Tongan Diplomatic Mission on the date of the funeral, Thursday 19th September 2019.
claims.locator: Gazette No. 28/477, English and Tongan notices
claims.uncertainty: A primary official record of the death, published by 16 September 2019. It does not state the date, time or place of death.

claims.text: Both notices are signed 'Hon. Semisi K.L. Sika, Acting Prime Minister of Tonga' (Tongan: 'Palemia Le'ole'o 'o Tonga').
claims.uncertainty: Attests Sika as Acting Prime Minister on 16 September 2019. The start of his acting service and its legal basis are not given. A claim on the role, not a holder.
